_doc: Curaçao L3-COUNTRY row for finance/model/country-reference.json (splice into countries{} during the cascade). Schema mirrors the French Polynesia row (high-cost, import-dependent, diesel-island-moderated-by-wind). Country key MUST match the 'country' field the Ocean Whisperer corridors carry ('Curaçao'). CAPEX is NOT here (opex/cost_index only) — the $1M hospitality tier is set in the CAPEX-tier logic via market.capex_tier='hospitality'.

captain_usd_yr.source: Modeled. ANG pegged to USD; tourism+refinery economy. Blended captain+deckhand ~$40k/vessel/yr, ~= Aruba.

energy_usd_kwh.source: Dutch govt report $0.35-0.38/kWh. Aqualectra fuel-oil + Tera Kora/Playa Kanoa wind; Aqualectra raising renewable share. Anchored $0.35.

grid_co2_kg_kwh.source: Fuel-oil base + wind parks. Anchored 0.60; upgradeable with Aqualectra official factor.

marina_overhead_usd_yr.source: Modeled. Spanish Water (Caracasbaai) + Willemstad premium island ops.

cost_index.source: Relative to Singapore=1.00. ~= Aruba; slightly lower general price level. Blended ~0.78.
